title: Provision S3 Data Lake with IAM Access Controls
description:
We need an S3-based data lake setup for the analytics team.

Requirements:
- S3 bucket: company-datalake-prod with versioning enabled
- Server-side encryption (AES-256) on all objects
- Block all public access settings enabled
- S3 lifecycle rule: transition objects to Glacier after 90 days
- IAM role for data-engineers team: read/write to bucket
- IAM role for data-analysts team: read-only to bucket
- CloudTrail data events enabled for the bucket
- Bucket policy denying non-HTTPS (non-TLS) requests
- All resources tagged: Environment=prod, Team=analytics, CostCenter=CC-105
context: Analytics team runs Spark jobs on EMR reading from this bucket. Region: us-east-1. Account: 123456789012. Use terraform-aws-modules/s3-bucket/aws ~> 4.0
